static_traits.name: Zhang Wei
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents; parents do not know about their sexual orientation
static_traits.social_status: Lacks social support to discuss sexual orientation with
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past; no similar problem history related to sexual orientation or family acceptance
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, cautious tone, tense and repressed emotions, fairly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: Distressed because my parents do not know about my sexual orientation, which brings me significant pain.
basic_info.core_demands: Needing to find a way to express honestly without damaging the relationship with parents.
growth_experiences: Long concealed sexual orientation from parents after becoming aware of it; feeling on high alert and inauthentic when family discusses marriage, settling down, etc., gradually keeping distance from parents to avoid exposure, causing tense daily interactions and experiences of isolation and lost authenticity.

Parents previously made contemptuous but non-hateful comments about other gay people, forming an anticipation of possible rejection and non-understanding from parents, increasing fear and avoidance of disclosure.

Long-term living with parents and lacking a social support network to talk about sexual orientation, making it hard to gain emotional support and reality-checking from others, reinforcing loneliness and anxiety.

core_beliefs: I will not be accepted by my parents.
The real me cannot be seen.

special_situations.event: When parents talk about my future (marriage, settling down)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not meet my parents' expectations of heterosexual marriage, they will reject me and the relationship will break.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding related topics, keeping distance, and continuing to conceal one's sexual orientation to maintain surface harmony.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not accept me; once they know they will distance from me.

special_situations.event: Hears parents make contemptuous comments about other homosexual people
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they hold contempt toward homosexuality, they will feel the same about me.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Being more cautious, not revealing any information related to sexual orientation.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They simply do not approve of homosexuality; I will be negated too.

special_situations.event: Conversations about romance and future plans arising in family or social situations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If relationship topics come up, I might expose my identity and be judged.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Deflecting topics, reducing self-disclosure, not building deep relationships with others.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Talking too much will give me away; people will look down on me.

special_situations.event: Having no one to confide in long-term, thinking about parents' reactions when feeling isolated and alone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Without support, I am even less able to bear possible rejection; better to keep hiding.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps silent, delays or cancels disclosure plans.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be able to be my true self.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be truly seen and accepted by one's parents.
core_conflict.fear: Fears being rejected and misunderstood by parents; relationship breakdown.
defense_goal: Maintains relationship stability and a sense of safety through concealment and keeping distance

object_relations.self_representation: A concealer fearing rejection and an obedient child
object_relations.object_representation: Conservative parents who may negate the self

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When parents or others talk about marriage, romance, or future plans
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to understand others' expectations as demands that one must live by heterosexual norms (transference: projecting early family expectations onto current interactions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a restrained, brief way, avoiding details, proactively deflecting topics, in a steady but distant tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests gradual disclosure or inquires about their support network
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating worries about the worst outcome after disclosure as inevitable, believing suggestions will endanger the relationship with parents (transference: projecting inner anticipation of rejection onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing reasons such as the parents being 'very stubborn', repeatedly explaining the risks of disclosure in a cautious, reserved tone, thereby refusing or postponing action.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When directly asked about their true feelings or invited to disclose more about oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying that exposing the true self will bring judgment or harm, tending to understand others' potential reactions as negation (transference: projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using vague, ambiguous wording, avoiding concrete details, in a hesitant tone; pulling the topic back to worries about others' possible reactions when necessary.

manifestations: Long concealing sexual orientation, feeling unable to live as the true self
Experiencing being constrained by others' expectations when family talks about marriage and the future
Lacking social support to talk about sexual orientation
Keeping distance from parents, avoiding intimate topics
Not building deep relationships with others

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Defaults to assuming oneself should meet parents' heterosexual marriage expectations
Reinforcing non-disclosure with reasons like 'they are very stubborn'
Uses others' expectations rather than her own needs as the standard of judgment in conversations

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Deflecting topics when romance or future topics arise

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Trusting no one, not building deep relationships with others
Extremely cautious and self-limiting attitude toward disclosure

positive_force: Values the relationship with parents, motivated to maintain family bonds
Has motivation to change and actively seeks help
Able to identify and name own negative thinking (e.g. predicting the future, overgeneralization)
negative_force: Intense fear of rejection and anticipation of the worst outcome
Lacking social support and the ability to trust others
Avoiding intimate topics and self-disclosure, causing relationship estrangement
Tending toward cognitive biases of overgeneralization and predicting the future

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding discussing romance and sexual orientation with parents, keeping distance
antecedent: Parents talking about marriage, settling down, and future plans
Relationship topics arising at family or social occasions
target_behavior.core_reason: Fears being rejected and misunderstood by parents, believes disclosure would damage the relationship
target_behavior.function: Avoids being judged and conflict, maintaining surface relationship stability
target_behavior.consequence: Communication becoming distant and inauthentic, long-term tension and anxiety, intensified sense of isolation

target_behavior.behavior: Not building deep relationships with others, social avoidance
antecedent: Worried others will learn of his sexual orientation
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged and negated, viewing others' reactions as negative
target_behavior.consequence: Forming isolation, lacking a support system, increased emotional stress
